meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Chat SDK 连接 Microsoft Teams，在团队频道、群聊和私聊中收发消息。它会检查现有凭据，没有就引导你完成登录、创建机器人、安装应用到 Teams，并把第一条消息发给指定的人。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Microsoft Teams 或要求添加 Teams 频道时触发；它会先检查是否已有配置，没有则进入引导流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 接到 Claude 里。
say.note: 会引导完成登录、创建机器人和安装。

say.text: 接入 Teams，机器人名字叫 NanoClaw。
say.note: 用指定名称创建应用和机器人。

say.text: 重新执行 Teams 集成设置。
say.note: 已有凭据时会跳过创建，直接继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains Microsoft Teams channel support via the Chat SDK, enabling chats in team channels, group chats and DMs. It checks for existing credentials and, if none, guides the user through login, bot creation and installation, then wires the bot to a specified owner.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add or set up Microsoft Teams integration. It first checks for existing credentials; if absent, it walks through login, creating a bot, and installing the app.

say_en.note: Starts setup: checks credentials, then guides login and bot creation.

say_en.text: Set up Teams with bot name NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Creates the Entra app, bot and Teams app under that name.
Safe to rerun; skips creation if credentials already exist.
